title: Long-term Follow-up of Subjects With Sickle Cell Disease Treated With Ex Vivo Gene Therapy Using Autologous Hematopoietic Stem Cells Transduced With a Lentiviral Vector
official: Long-term Follow-up of Subjects With Sickle Cell Disease Treated With Ex Vivo Gene Therapy Using Autologous Hematopoietic Stem Cells Transduced With a Lentiviral Vector
summary:
Main objective: - Evaluate long-term safety of treatment with lovocel (lovotibeglogene autotemcel, also known as bb1111 or LentiGlobin BB305 Drug Product for Sickle Cell Disease) in subjects with sickle cell disease (SCD)
- Evaluate long-term efficacy of treatment with bb1111 in subjects with SCD

interventions.name: LentiGlobin BB305 Drug Product for Sickle Cell Disease

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Provision of written informed consent for this study by subject, or as  applicable, subject's parent(s)/ legal guardian(s)
2. Treated with drug product for therapy of SCD in a bluebird bio-sponsored clinical study
Exclusion criteria:
1. There are no exclusion criteria for this study.
